needs_ruling: after the first saying, «وقال سفيان بن عبد الله الثقفي قال وكان يحمي لهم واديين» gives a second speaker with no written isnad of its own; whether it is a second route is not settled, so Sufyan is not added
«- ونسبه إلى عبد الرحمن بن الحارث المخزومي -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«أن شبابة، - بطن من فهم -» names a tribe, the subject of the saying, not a transmitter; «فذكر نحوه» is a wording note
the dashed gloss «ونسبه إلى عبد الرحمن بن الحارث المخزومي» is an editor's gloss and is left out; the speaker of «حدثني أبي» is therefore not named in the text, so no link is added for him (rule 6)
«وقال سفيان بن عبد الله الثقفي» is a different transmitter for the added words of the same saying: a variant group, never a route
